name: find_event_causals
description: Find causal edges between events. event_id matches either endpoint and takes precedence over from/to.

event_id.description: Optional event UUID that must appear as from or to.

from.description: Optional cause event UUID filter (от какого события).

to.description: Optional effect event UUID filter (к какому событию).

limit.description: Maximum number of causal edges to return. Defaults to 20.
